contents.text:
Good morning, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. Not today. The chat doesn't take card payments, and that isn't something the site does yet.

What it does do is ask before it sends anything. Look at the card on your screen: nothing leaves the page until the visitor says yes, and then Louis gets the request once.

Would you like to see a booking come through a business's own agent?

arguments.question: Shall I take you to one?

choices.label: See a demo
choices.why: A guesthouse books a room live, in its own window.

choices.label: Tell me more
choices.why: How it asks before it sends, step by step.

choices.label: Not now
choices.why: No problem, the page will be here.
